message: `{word}` is not part of Verilog-A: Annex C excludes it, because its don't-care matching works on four-state logic values (`x`, `z`) that an analog value cannot hold; use `case`
description: `casex` and `casez` treat `x` and `z` bits as don't-care when matching. Verilog-A values are real numbers with no such bits, so the language excludes both.
actions: Use `case`, and list the values to match explicitly.
